podcast.title: Mother of Astile Louis Dockerty (January 2003)
podcast.body: In January 2003, Lisa Moorish had a son, Astile Louis Dockerty, whose father is Pete Doherty, the singer of The Libertines. "January 2003, Lisa had a son, a steel, Louis Dockerty."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Mother of Molly Moorish
podcast.body: She gave birth to a daughter named Molly in March 1998, who was later confirmed to be Liam Gallagher's child. "In March of 1998, however, she gave birth to a little girl named Molly."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Relationship with Liam Gallagher
podcast.body: Lisa Moorish, a minor pop star, dated Liam Gallagher on and off for about two years and had an encounter with him in Los Angeles in June 1997, two months after his marriage to Patsy Kensit. "She was a minor pop star at the time. Liam and Lisa had dated on and off for about two years."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

xref.title: Affair with Lisa Moorish (June 1997)
xref.body: Two months after his marriage to Patsy Kensit, Liam Gallagher had an encounter with Lisa Moorish, a minor pop star with whom he had previously dated on and off for about two years. This "one more fling" occurred in Los Angeles. "Two months later, there was an encounter with a woman named Lisa Murish."

xref.body: In March 1998, Lisa Moorish gave birth to a daughter named Molly, who was later determined to be Liam's child. "In March of 1998, however, she gave birth to a little girl named Molly. And it was later determined that Molly's daddy was Liam."

xref.title: Father of Astile Louis Dockerty
xref.body: Pete Doherty, known as the "famous drug-addled singer" of The Libertines and Babyshambles, is the father of Astile Louis Dockerty, born to Lisa Moorish in January 2003. "And before you ask, yes, the father is Pete Dockerty, the famous drug-addled singer of the Liberty's."
